name: @media-router/plugin-mpegts-core
description: Library plugin (no mediaRouter manifest — never appears in Add Module): MPEG-TS domain base code. The C++ mrts core that implements TS timing once (packet walk, PSI, PES, PCR, the house-clock timescales, the virtual STC, the ingest restamp, the capture ASRC servo, the TS splitter, the H.264/H.265 SPS probe) and the GStreamer plugins on it (libgstmrtshouse.so, mrtsstamp, mrlateness); the python reference modules (the reference, not loaded for any new path), the parity-test fixtures, and the TS-side PMT descriptor-loop reader every TS plugin walks ES descriptors with.

scripts.test:py: cd py && python3 ts_psi_test.py && python3 ts_split_test.py && python3 ts_video_info_test.py && python3 ts_timeline_test.py && python3 video_pace_test.py && python3 video_pace_parity_test.py && python3 asrc_device_ref_test.py
